title: State of the Trenches, 2026-W44: fees −11.3% week over week
dek: Launchpad fees were $19.82M across 14 non-overlapping venues and creator earnings $10.34M; Coins paired with tokenized stocks led narrative volume.

body.text: The covered launchpad fee subtotal for 2026-W44 (Oct 26, 2026 to Nov 1, 2026, UTC) was $19.82M across 14 non-overlapping venues, −11.3% against 2026-W43 on the same venues. 5 venues that share a fee stream with another venue are reported individually and never added.
Creator earnings — fees paid to coin creators and, depending on the venue's own definition, holders, referrers or traders — were $10.34M across 15 venues that define them, −6.3% week over week.
By share of the subtotal, LaunchLab gained the most (+2.1 points) and Pons lost the most (-2.4 points). A share shift says where fees moved, not why.

Trading in the coins of the tracked narratives totalled $378.18M for the week, counting a coin once when it belongs to more than one narrative (the per-narrative totals add up to $408.4M). This is the volume of identified coins across their indexed pools, not of the whole market.

Coins paired with tokenized stocks carried the most volume among narratives collected during the week: $175.83M (partial: some member-days were not observed). On the 4 members fully observed in both weeks, volume changed +85.9%.

First observed this week: Anthropic IPO coins, Binance hack coins, 2028 presidential-run coins, Zcash launchpad coins, Lightberry Lumi coins. A narrative's first week has no meaningful prior week, so no change is reported for it.

Collection paused during the week: Launchpad and launch-tool coins, 2028 presidential-run coins, AI inference market coins, GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins, Perpetual-futures coins, PHP2Shell coins. Their members stay members; their totals after the pause are partial, not zero.
